summary: Reject email-address suffixes in the shared normalizer and conditionally clean complete addresses before exact reference extraction without hiding later real relationships.
decision_refs: Active user goal to continue improving accuracy across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Confirmed synthetic reproduction where current-body and quoted-history addresses created false reviewer groups
approval_evidence: The active user goal explicitly includes continued RFI, Submittal and Email accuracy improvements.
known_limitations: The conservative bounded pattern targets conventional complete email-address tokens and does not attempt full RFC mailbox grammar.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no mailbox, model, external provider or customer file was used.
